svg.title: A finished warning sign with three measured limits
svg.desc: A bold warning sign headed do not use this model for, followed by three specific limitations each carrying a measured number, and a footer stating the date and the number of unseen photos the numbers came from.
svg.text: The boldest thing on the poster
DO NOT USE THIS MODEL FOR...

g.text: It was right 4 times out of 12. That is 33.3%.
...anything where a wrong answer costs something.
Overall it was right 30 times out of 48. That is 62.5%.
Comb scored 8 out of 16, which is 50.0%. A coin does that.

svg.text: Measured on 48 photos the model had never seen. Tested 4 September 2026 by R. Kumar.
Anyone can publish a good number. Publishing the boundary is what makes you trustworthy.
